title: Gotrade Daily: CPI Tonight as BofA and Morgan Stanley Report
summary: September CPI is due tonight as Bank of America and Morgan Stanley report Q3 results and chip stocks extend their slide. See tonight's Gotrade Daily watchlist.
body_markdown:

Stock Movement What to Watch


[BAC](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/bac/) Reports around 6:45am ET Consensus EPS of $1.10; a $1.2 billion fine charge lands in Q3 earnings

## Tonight's Key Events


### September CPI


In August, US headline inflation was 3.4% year over year and core inflation was 2.4%. For September, core forecasts cluster around 0.2% month over month, while headline inflation is expected to rise on energy prices ([Admiral Markets](https://admiralmarkets.com/analytics/traders-blog/us-cpi-preview-september-2026-forecasts-and-the-core-cpi-outlook) ). Traders widely expect the Fed to hold rates this month, although a December rate increase remains possible ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-muted-after-chip-losses-drag-wall-street-cpi-data-awaited-4947807) ).


### Bank of America and Morgan Stanley report


**Bank of America** ([BAC](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/bac/) ) is scheduled to report around 6:45am ET and **Morgan Stanley** ([MS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ms/) ) around 7:30am ET ([INDmoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/us-bank-earnings-q3-jpm-bac-gs-wfc-citi-blk-ms-stock-earnings) ). US regulators fined Bank of America a total of $1.21 billion over failures to detect potential money laundering. The bank said the $1.2 billion charge will cut third-quarter net income by about 17 cents a share ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/bofa-fined-12-billion-by-us-government-for-failing-to-police-suspicious-activity-4947537) ).
